Method of Attack: Selling fake Android cryptocurrency mining applications that do not provide any cloud cryptomining functionality
Scamming victims by charging for additional services and non-existent app upgrades
Accepting payments via Google Play in-app billing system and cryptocurrency transfers (Bitcoin and Ethereum for BitScam)
Attack Vector: Distribution via Google Play Store and third-party app stores
Side-loading of apps from third-party stores
Indicators of Compromise: 172 paid Android applications (83,800 installs for BitScam, 9,600 installs for CloudScam)
Apps advertised as cloud cryptocurrency mining services but contain no mining functionality
Payments made via Google Play in-app billing and cryptocurrency wallets
